title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Style of the Case File Retrieval Letter for Civil and Administrative Protest Cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Template for Letter to Request Case Files in Civil and Administrative Protest Cases"

Fa Fa [2004] No. 8

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to standardize the People's Courts' adjudication of civil and administrative protest cases filed by the People's Procuratorates, and in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law, the Administrative Procedure Law, and relevant judicial interpretations, if the People's Court that accepts the protest cannot promptly issue a ruling to suspend the enforcement of the original judgment, it shall, when requesting the case files of the original trial, notify the enforcement court or relevant enforcement authority to temporarily suspend the enforcement of the original judgment until the ruling for retrial is made.

We hereby issue the template for the letter to request case files and temporarily suspend enforcement in civil and administrative protest cases formulated by our court. Please implement it accordingly.

March 9, 2004

Template One

______ People's Court

Letter to Request Case Files

(For use in adjudicating civil and administrative protest cases from the People's Procuratorate)

( ) Zi No. ______

______ People's Court:

The People's Procuratorate of ______ has filed a protest against the judgment ( ) Zi No. ______ of the ______ People's Court in the case of ______ (specify parties and cause of action) ______ dispute.

You are requested, immediately upon receipt of this letter, to notify the lower enforcement court and the enforcement division of this court to temporarily suspend the enforcement of the original judgment, and to gather and submit to this court all case files for the first instance, second instance, retrial, review, and enforcement (select as needed) within ______ days.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)

Clerk: ______

Template Two

______ People's Court

Letter to Request Case Files

(For use in adjudicating civil and administrative protest cases from the People's Procuratorate)

( ) Zi No. ______

______ People's Court:

The People's Procuratorate of ______ has filed a protest against the judgment ( ) Zi No. ______ of the ______ People's Court in the case of ______ (specify parties and cause of action) ______ dispute.

You are requested, immediately upon receipt of this letter, to notify the lower enforcement court and the enforcement division of this court to temporarily suspend the enforcement of the original judgment, and to gather and submit to this court all case files for the first instance, second instance, retrial, review, and enforcement (select as needed) within ______ days.

______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

(Court Seal)
Issuing Officer: ______ Handler: ______
(This copy is to be kept in the case file)

Explanation of the Template for Letter to Request Case Files

1. This template is to be used by Intermediate People's Courts and above when, upon receiving a protest from the People's Procuratorate in civil or administrative cases, they are unable to promptly issue a ruling for retrial.

2. The function of this letter is to clarify that, while requesting the case files from the lower court, the enforcement of the original effective judgment shall be temporarily suspended until the ruling for retrial to suspend enforcement is issued.

3. This template is a fill-in form, made in duplicate: one copy is sent to the relevant lower court, and one copy is retained in the case file.

4. For the case files to be requested, selection may be made among "first instance, second instance, retrial, review, enforcement" case files, or the case numbers of the relevant cases may be appended after the letter.
